name: Venus Blood -AfterDays- Episode:5 Onsen'yado no Shugo Megami
original_name: VenusBlood -AfterDays- Episode:5 温泉宿の守護女神
source:
The Floating Continent of Yggdrasil is now at peace, and the Overlord Loki has begun reconstruction efforts on the continent following the end of the war.

As he was travelling the continent checking up on the various countries, he decided to pay a visit to Glads, where the Goddess of Winter, Rigret, welcomed him warmly to her newly built hot spring inn.

He decides to spend a few days there together with her...

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ninetail/venusblood-frontier-fandiscs-english-localisation-project]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
Yggdrasil的漂浮大陆现在处于和平状态，霸主洛基在战争结束后开始了该大陆的重建工作。

当他在大陆巡视各国时，他决定去拜访格拉兹，那里的冬季女神雷格丽特热情地欢迎他来到她新建的温泉旅馆。

他决定和她一起在那里度过几天……

[来自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ninetail/venusblood-frontier-fandiscs-english-localisation-project]Kickstarter[/url]]
